_comment: __text baseline for the binary-size CI gate (see devkit bench size check and .github/workflows/binary_size.yml). Measured osx-arm64, 2026-10-04, on mojo 1.2.0.dev2026092105. Regenerate after an intentional size change with: pixi run -e dev python -m devkit bench size check --update. Re-recorded for the native LZ4 and Zstandard codecs, accepted as a deliberate cost: query_cli +48,000 (+1.49%), the zstd and lz4 decoders where it had dlopen calls and keeping liblz4 and libzstd selectable (native_codecs=False), and query_streaming and query_expr2_streaming +0.19%. The other gates measure 2.3-3.4% under the previous floors on main as it stands, and are recorded as measured.
